kb.title: Password reset
kb.content: Users can reset passwords via Settings > Security > Reset Password. Check spam folder for reset emails.

kb.title: Duplicate charges
kb.content: Duplicate charges are refunded within 5 business days. Provide order ID and bank statement.

kb.title: iOS crash troubleshooting
kb.content: Force quit app, clear cache, reinstall from App Store. Known issue in v3.2.1 fixed in v3.2.2.

kb.title: Refund policy
kb.content: Full refund within 7 days of purchase. Cancellations after 7 days are prorated.

kb.title: 2FA recovery
kb.content: Contact support with government ID for 2FA reset. Allow 24 hours for verification.

kb.title: Invoice tax details
kb.content: Tax breakdown appears on downloadable PDF invoices under Billing > Invoices.

kb.title: Desktop sync errors
kb.content: For sync error 504, sign out, clear local cache, and sign back in. Retry after 10 minutes.

kb.title: Change login email
kb.content: Email changes require verification from both old and new addresses in Account Settings.

kb.title: API rate limits
kb.content: Default limit is 1000 requests/minute. Upgrade plan or request temporary limit increase.

kb.title: Cancel subscription
kb.content: Annual plans can be cancelled anytime; access remains until period end. No auto-renew after cancellation.

kb.title: Database connection timeouts
kb.content: DB-504 indicates connection pool exhaustion. Restart app servers and scale read replicas. Check status page for incidents.

kb.title: Annual plan refund requests
kb.content: Annual plan refunds within 7 days require order ID and verified account number. Prorated refunds after 7 days.

kb.title: Merged account billing disputes
kb.content: When work and personal accounts are merged, charges may post to the surviving account. Provide both account IDs and dispute the charge for reallocation.

kb.title: Webhook delivery failures
kb.content: Verify webhook endpoint URL, retry queue, and signing secret. Check delivery logs under Developer > Webhooks > Events.

kb.title: Database migration connection issues
kb.content: After cluster migration, update connection strings and verify pool settings. DB-504 indicates pool exhaustion — restart app servers and scale replicas.

kb.title: SSL certificate renewal
kb.content: Custom domain SSL certificates renew automatically. If expired, re-verify domain ownership under Settings > Domains > SSL.

kb.title: API outage escalation
kb.content: For regional 503 outages on priority SLA accounts, escalate to engineering on-call and reference status page incident ID.
